meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做出一份可点击、能分支跳转、带演讲备注的演示幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把想法或网页做成能上台演示的交互幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Build a clickable presentation deck with branching and speaker notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas or a webpage into an interactive deck to present.

howto.what: Claude 会把你要讲的内容做成可导航的 HyperFrames 幻灯片组：离散幻灯片、分步显现、分支跳转、热点导航，以及带演讲者备注的放映模式；也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可播放的幻灯片组，不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片（slideshow）时直接开始；若你只说“演示”“pitch deck”等相邻说法，或要求把现有页面转成幻灯片，它会先问你确认是否要做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片，确认后才动手。

say.text: 把这份 pitch deck 做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片
say.note: 它会先确认是否要做成幻灯片再开始

say.text: 把这个网页转成可导航的幻灯片
say.note: 尽量保留原页面的设计与交互

say.text: 给这张幻灯片加上演讲者备注
say.note: 备注只给演讲者看，观众看不到

howto.what_en: Claude turns your material into a navigable HyperFrames deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation and presenter mode with speaker notes; it can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a live deck, not a rendered MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow. If you only say "presentation", "pitch deck" or ask to convert a page, it pauses and confirms before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this pitch deck into a HyperFrames slideshow
Convert this page into a navigable deck
say_en.note: Keeps the source page's design and interactions

say_en.text: Add speaker notes to this slide
say_en.note: Notes are presenter-only, hidden from the audience
